newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel prices edge lower tracking ACCESS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel prices edge lower tracking ACCESS.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices edged slightly lower tracking ACCESS futures late Tuesday, players said, following new weekly API data showing an unsurprising 1.3 million barrel build in distillate stocks.
API pegged jet fuel output at 1.67 million barrels a day, a smidgen stronger than the prior week but nearly 258,000 bpd more than last year.
New York Harbor 54-grade jet was offered at about 0.50 cent over November heat, 0.15 cent firmer than Monday diffs. Gulf material firmed 0.25 cent to 1.50 cent below the screen, traders said.
